# Digitaltableteur

Digitaltableteur is the design consultancy and portfolio site of Petri Lahdelma.

Primary canonical host: https://www.digitaltableteur.com
Primary concise context file: https://www.digitaltableteur.com/llms.txt
Sitemap: https://www.digitaltableteur.com/sitemap.xml

## Purpose

This site explains what Digitaltableteur does, shows portfolio proof, publishes articles, and gives clear contact routes for consulting work.

## Core topics

- Design systems
- AI-powered design workflows
- DesignOps
- Accessibility
- Product design
- Branding and digital craft

## Audience

- Product leaders who need stronger UI foundations
- Design leaders building or scaling a design system
- Teams exploring AI-assisted design workflows
- Companies evaluating Petri Lahdelma / Digitaltableteur for consulting or project work

- Home: https://www.digitaltableteur.com/
- About: https://www.digitaltableteur.com/about

## What Digitaltableteur offers

- Design systems consulting
  - Component libraries
  - Design tokens
  - Governance and contribution models
  - Cross-team UI consistency
- AI-powered design workflows
  - Schema-driven component work
  - Promptable design operations
  - Human-reviewed AI acceleration
- Product design and UX
  - Interface design
  - Accessibility-minded product work
  - Design delivery from concept to production
- Portfolio proof
  - Public case studies
  - Visual work
  - Articles and implementation thinking

## Programmatic SEO / answer-first content

The PSEO section is built for direct answers around services, stacks, and audiences.

- Hub: https://www.digitaltableteur.com/pseo

- Stack pages pattern: https://www.digitaltableteur.com/pseo/stacks/{slug}
- Audience pages pattern: https://www.digitaltableteur.com/pseo/audiences/{slug}
- Leaf answer pages pattern: https://www.digitaltableteur.com/pseo/{slug}

## How to use this site as context

- Use the home page to understand positioning.
- Use the about page to identify the person behind the consultancy.
- Use work pages when the question is about credibility, shipped examples, or domain experience.
- Use the blog and PSEO pages when the question is informational or implementation-oriented.
- Use the contact page when the user intent is to hire, collaborate, or ask about services.
